title: Unable to add 2 videos from Quick Create - same error as before (Web + Mobile)

scenarios.title: Select 2 videos together via Browse Device in Quick Create
steps: Open Features Dashboard > Quick Create > Create From Media.
Select 2 video files at once in the OS file picker.
scenarios.expected: Both videos are accepted, item strip shows 'Item 1 of 2 / 2 Videos', preview plays, no error message.
scenarios.risk_note: Original bug: adding 2 videos failed with a recurring error. Re-Open history means this needs re-verification after each related fix.

scenarios.title: Select 3 videos at once (beyond the ticket's 2-video case)
steps: Select 3 video files at once instead of 2.
scenarios.expected: Either all 3 are accepted cleanly, or the app shows a clear limit message (no silent failure/broken state).
scenarios.risk_note: Checks whether the fix is specifically hardcoded for '2' or handles N videos generally.

scenarios.title: 2-video upload on a mobile viewport
steps: Same entry flow as P01, but with browser viewport/UA emulating iPhone 13.
scenarios.expected: Same as P01 on mobile layout — ticket explicitly says 'Web + Mobile'.
scenarios.risk_note: Original bug report covered both Web and Mobile; desktop-only testing would miss a mobile-specific regression.

execution.flow: Home > Quick Create > Create From Media > Browse Device
findings: P01: both videos accepted, item strip showed 'Item 1 of 2, 2 Videos', preview played, Trim Video option available, no error text.
N01: 3 videos also accepted cleanly, item strip showed 'Item 1 of 3, 3 Videos' — no hard cap at 2, no broken state.

E01: on iPhone 13 viewport emulation, 2-video upload behaved the same as desktop — 'Item 1 of 2', preview playable, no error. (Video letterboxing seen in the mobile player is normal video-aspect-ratio behavior, not the same defect as POCI-175's image-crop bug — noted for awareness, not flagged as a bug.)
Consistent with prior manual UAT2 sign-off noted in ticket comments.
not_covered: Mixing images and videos in the same upload
Very large video file (upload timeout/size-limit behavior)
Native mobile app (only mobile *web* viewport was emulated, not a real device/app)
